description_excerpt: Job Description • Update and maintain global account data in Salesforce, including price and volume information • Manage acquisition tracking activities and monitor campaign performance • Support CF price planning and price management initiatives • Modify price, volume, and competitor data based on requests from customer teams • Verify accuracy of current data and input new information into systems • Assist with organization and coordination of sales planning activities Qualifications • Currently enrolled at or recently graduated from a university program • No prior work experience required…
